failure_or_lesson: A candidate row carrying an active label is not an authorization decision. Separate persisted candidate lineage from the active head and bind promotion to an independently verified Experience event.
goal: Require an exact independently authenticated approval before a versioned personal-state candidate can become consumable active state.
notes: This boundary does not provide a production authenticated owner/policy adapter, a learned updater, or behavioral qualification.
procedure: Construct a private request with the candidate subject, version, hash, and expected active predecessor. Record an exact approval event in KurrentDB; require a trusted product verifier to authenticate it; CAS an active head in XTDB. On read, recheck source evidence and the event/payload/verifier. A synthetic verifier is used only for the infrastructure test.
validation: Real selected-backend run 36574357535 passed exact KurrentDB approval binding, negative synthetic verifier, XTDB activation, idempotent retry, and revalidated active read.
